Class OfferPath

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.board.offerpath.OfferPath
public class OfferPath extends Object
Manages the offer path where players place their totems to draft cards. Also controls the starting tile, orchestrating the transition of players between the starting blocks and the offer spaces, and determining the new turn order.

    • setup

      public void setup(List<Player> players)
      Configures the offer path and the starting tile for the beginning of the game, tailoring the available spaces and blocks to the exact number of players.
      Parameters:
      players - The list of players in the game.

    • returnPlayerToStartingTile

      public void returnPlayerToStartingTile(Player player)
      Moves a player from their current offer space back to the starting tile. Clears the occupied offer space and automatically places the player on the first available starting block.
      Parameters:
      player - The player who has just completed their active turn.

    • getPlayersInOrder

      public List<Player> getPlayersInOrder()
      Determines the new turn order by extracting players from currently occupied spaces, sorted from left to right (by the space's position index), it skips offer space A as it was already resolved
      Returns:
      A sorted list of players representing the turn order for the next turn step.

    • getNextRoundTurnOrder

      public List<Player> getNextRoundTurnOrder()
      Retrieves the turn order for the upcoming round based on the players' positions on the starting tile blocks.
      Returns:
      A list of players sorted by their new turn order.

    • resolveEventA

      public void resolveEventA()
      Checks if the offer space 'A' is currently occupied by a player. If occupied, it immediately resolves the space's specific effect for that player and returns the player to the starting tile . If the space is empty or unavailable, it does nothing.

    • checkOfferSpace

      public boolean checkOfferSpace(String targetCode)
      Checks if a specific offer space exists in the current game and is not already occupied.
      Parameters:
      targetCode - The unique string code of the target offer space (e.g., "A", "B").
      Returns:
      True if the space is valid and currently available, false otherwise.

    • placePlayer

      public void placePlayer(Player player, String targetCode)
      Places a player's totem on the specified offer space.
      Parameters:
      player - The player taking the space.
      targetCode - The unique string code of the target offer space.

    • resolveActionForPlayer

      public int[] resolveActionForPlayer(Player player)
      Retrieves the specific drafting rules for the specified player based on the space they currently occupy.
      Parameters:
      player - The player whose active turn is being resolved.
      Returns:
      An int[] containing the drafting rules: index 0 is the number of cards to draw from the upper row, and index 1 from the lower row.
